title: Returns & refunds
keywords: return refund money back purchase cancellation
text: Unused products can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Include your order number when requesting a return. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days after inspection. Digital downloads are refundable only before download.

title: Shipping & delivery
keywords: shipping delivery ship tracking package international
text: Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days. Express shipping takes 1–2 business days. Orders above $75 qualify for free standard shipping. Tracking details are sent after dispatch. This sample store ships within the United States only.

title: Billing & payments
keywords: payment pay invoice billing card receipt
text: The sample store accepts major credit and debit cards. Receipts are emailed after a successful payment. Request a business invoice by providing your order number and company details. Payment details are handled by the payment provider and are not stored by the store.

title: Account access
keywords: password reset login account sign access locked
text: Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page to request a reset email. Reset links expire after 30 minutes. Check your spam folder if the email does not arrive. Support will never ask for your password.
